answer.answer: The median concentration rose by a factor of about 93.7x (from 0.00214 to 0.200429 pieces/m3), but this comes from only 3 studies in 2000-2004 versus 17 in 2020-2024 with no overlapping studies, so it reflects differences in sampling locations, methods, and study composition rather than a true temporal trend in ocean microplastic levels.
